Open.current: Reported by {reporter} and awaiting assignment. Nothing has been actioned yet.

InProgress.current: {assignee} is actively working this ticket. It will move to Resolved once the fix is confirmed.
InProgress.upcoming: Starts once the ticket is assigned and work begins.

Resolved.current: The reported issue has been fixed. It stays here until the owner formally closes the ticket.
Resolved.done: The reported issue was fixed and confirmed.
Resolved.upcoming: Marked once the assigned work is completed and verified.

Closed.current: This ticket is fully closed and archived. No further action is needed.
Closed.done: Archived — no further action was needed.
Closed.upcoming: The final step once the owner signs off after resolution.
